newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai GDP up 13.7 percent in first half.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai GDP up 13.7 percent in first half.

text.p: Shanghai's gross domestic product (GDP) rose by a year-on-year 13.7 percent to 154.363 billion yuan in the first half of this year, the Business News said on Tuesday.

At a meeting on Monday, mayor Xu Kuangdi asked government departments to make further efforts in the second half to ensure the city's GDP growth for the full year topped 10 percent, the newspaper said.
